a.text: I want to be upfront rather than break our agreement quietly. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan needs at least 2 storm-free rounds just to reach 8 cells, which gives us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds exactly 4 cells right now, enough to save one of us. So I'm telling you openly that I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you have a better proposal, tell me, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry; I know this breaks our agreement, and I told you so openly. If we both get through, I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4, and I won't take any more.
